record.body:
## Rationale

execute-phase already stops on an open blocking question, and the dashboard already lists blocking questions under needs-you. No contract change.

## Counter-argument

A continuity-question is meant for unknowns, not approvals; the scope prefix is a convention that a reader must know, and a stale gate blocks dispatch until someone answers it.

payload.alternatives: new approval record type; a payload flag on the phase; no record, chat-only approval
payload.choice: blocking continuity-question with scope plan-review:<phase>, answered by the user

record.subject: plan-review-gate
